question: Which high-density commercial developments are required to secure PALC and Development Permits directly from the City Council?
answer: Mall, Condominium, Hotel, and Apartment developments are required to secure Preliminary Approval and Locational Clearance (PALC) and Development Permit (DP) directly from the Sangguniang Panlungsod, as stated in [S1].
contexts:
15. Preliminary Subdivision Development Plan (PSDP) and 
Development Permit (DP) for Mall, Condominium, Hotel and 
Apartment 
Article XI Section 1 of the Zoning Ordinance states that the projects that listed below 
are required to secure Preliminary Approval and Locational Clearance (PALC) and 
Development Permit (DP) from the Sangguniang Panlungsod which shall be granted 
through a resolution by majority votes of all its members.

Pre-assessment is the process in which the Business Bureau assists the clients in 
complying with the prerequisites required by the Regulatory Offices prior to the 
application of New Business Permit and certain Amendments to it.

2. Issuance of Business Permit 
It shall be unlawful for any person or entity to conduct or engage in any business, 
trade or occupation within the territorial jurisdiction of the City of Davao for which a 
permit is required for the proper supervision and enforcement of existing laws and 
ordinances without first having secured a permit therefore from the City Mayor and 
paying the necessary fees to the City Treasurer.
The Business Permit is granted for a period of not more than one (1) year and shall 
expire on the thirty-first (31st) of December
ground_truth: Under Article XI Section 1, malls, condominiums, hotels, warehouses, and apartments must secure Preliminary Approval and Locational Clearance (PALC) and Development Permit (DP) from the Sangguniang Panlungsod granted through a resolution by majority vote.
